mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the Rank IC of FEDFUNDS with 20-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate signals economic weakness, leading to negative investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the Rank IC of UNRATE with 20-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP signals a weakening economy, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods following a GDP decline, or if the Rank IC of GDPC1 with 60-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production signals strong economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the Rank IC of INDPRO with 5-day returns is below 0.1 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 5% and CPI inflation is rising, the combination signals a restrictive monetary environment that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the Rank IC of the interaction term with 20-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase significantly and the unemployment rate decreases, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the Rank IC of the interaction term with 20-day returns is below 0.1 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts signals increased demand for housing and related sectors, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the Rank IC of HOUST with 60-day returns is below 0.1 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the Rank IC of RSAFS with 5-day returns is below 0.1 over a 2-year rolling window.
